items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued July 10 at 9:53PM AKDT until July 12 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 40 mph expected.

* WHERE...Lower Yukon and Innoko Valleys and Upper Kuskokwim Valley.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Saturday to 1 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Lower Yukon and Innoko Valleys; Upper Kuskokwim Valley
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 10 at 9:52PM AKDT until July 11 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees.

* WHERE...Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.instruction:

relatives and neighbors.

under any circumstances as vehicle interiors can reach extreme

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued July 10 at 2:45PM AKDT until July 11 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* Winds...Southeast 15 to 25 mph. Gusts up to 40 mph.

* Timing...Hot, dry, windy conditions expected to begin by noon,
persisting into the evening, as temperatures cool by 7pm.

* Relative Humidity...As low as 20 percent.

* Temperatures...In the lower to mid 70s for lower elevations.

* Location...Areas along the Copper and Chitina Rivers.

* Impacts...Rapid ignition, growth and spread of fires will be
possible.
items.areas: Central Copper Valley; Southern Copper Valley; McCarthy

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 10 at 12:16PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
South winds will increase from 12PM to 10PM Saturday with gusts
to around 40 mph. The recent heavy rain has loosened soil and root
systems making the trees more susceptible to falling. Wind gusts
up to 40 mph can result in downed trees and isolated power
outages during this time.

If you see downed trees or power lines, please notify authorities
and do not approach them as it can be hazardous.
